jobs.description:
Bring your life 
Are you passionate about developing products where safety, engineering excellence, and user experience come together? Are you excited about developing innovative, safe, and functional solutions for families who love outdoor adventures? If you're driven by the challenge of designing products that combine cutting-edge technology with the highest standards of safety and comfort for children, then this is the perfect opportunity for you! 
As part of our Active with Kids category, you'll contribute to solutions that combine thoughtful design, engineering excellence, and industry-leading safety. With an exciting product portfolio and roadmap ahead, you'll help to shape the next generation of strollers that make adventures with kids safer, easier, and more enjoyable. 
 
What you'll do at Thule 
As a Mechanical Design Engineer - Active with Kids, you'll be part of our committed engineering team specifically developing strollers. Together, we take ideas from concept to finished product through a structured and collaborative development process. 
In this role, you will design and develop components in CAD, create high-quality technical specifications, and collaborate closely with engineering colleagues, project managers, simulation and test engineers, and prototype specialists to solve technical challenges and ensure every detail meets the high standards and requirements. 
You will take an active role in ordering and evaluating prototypes, analyzing test results, and using simulations to verify the strength and performance of your designs. 
In addition, you will document technical solutions, manage design-related risks, and contribute to engineering best practices. Leading and supporting design reviews will be an important part of your role, helping ensure our products meet the highest standards of safety, quality, and sustainability. 
 
What you bring 
To succeed in this role, we believe you have a university degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field, combined with some years of experience in mechanical design and product development. 
You have worked with a variety of materials and understand how to optimize designs for functionality, durability, and safety. Experience from consumer products, the automotive industry, or other safety-critical applications is highly valuable. You have experience working with plastic components and understand their manufacturing processes. You are fluent in both Swedish and English. 
As the role includes practical elements, we believe you thrive in a hands-on product development environment. As a person, you are self-driven, structured, and solution-oriented, with the ability to turn ideas into robust and well-engineered products. You are a team player who enjoys collaborating across disciplines and can effectively manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously. 
 
Why you should join Thule 
At Thule, we are Proud to Be Thule. We believe anything is possible when we stay curious, take initiative and challenge ourselves. We encourage everyone to take ownership and make the most of their part of the business. 
We believe we win as a team by collaborating across functions, sharing knowledge and supporting one another. United by our passion for our products, the outdoors and the Thule brand, we take pride in what we do and create a culture where everyone contributes, grows and has fun. 
 
Hiring Process 
Apply by submitting your application and resumé through “Apply for position” on our Thule Career Site. The application deadline is December 6, 2026. 
Please make sure to not wait to show your interest until the last application date as interviews are held continuously during the process, and the position might be filled before the last application date. Please also note that we do not accept applications by e-mail. 
If you have any questions about the role, feel free to contact our Talent Acquisition Partner, Oscar Persson, at Oscar.persson@thule.com 
We look forward to hearing from you! 
Thule is a global sports and outdoor company. We offer high-quality products with smart features and a sustainable design that make it easy for people across the globe to live an active life. Under the motto Bring your life — and with a focus on consumer-driven innovation and long-term sustainability — we develop, manufacture and market products within the product categories Sport & Cargo Carriers (roof racks, roof boxes and carriers for transporting cycling, water and winter sports equipment, and rooftop tents mounted on a car), Active with Kids & Dogs (car seats, strollers, bike trailers, child bike seats and dog transport), RV Products (awnings, bike carriers and tents for RVs and caravans) and Bags & Mounts (backpacks, luggage and performance mounts).
Thule Group has about 3,000 employees at nine production facilities and 35 sales offices worldwide. The Group’s products are sold in 138 markets and in 2025, sales amounted to SEK 10,4 billion.

Cambio is one of the Nordics' leading suppliers in e-health with a comprehensive offering for the entire health and care chain. Our e-health solutions supports health care professionals in their daily work and offer patients safer and more easily accessible care. We are proud to be an important part of Swedish healthcare. We are growing continuously and now have about 1000 employees in several countries.
The position
As a Clinical Evaluator at Cambio, you will play an important role in ensuring that our medical devices are supported by robust clinical evidence and meet applicable requirements for clinical safety and performance.
You will independently plan and conduct clinical evaluations while working closely with a cross-functional Clinical Evaluation Team combining expertise in the device, its intended use and the relevant clinical area. You will collaborate with colleagues across Regulatory Affairs, Risk Management, Post-Market Surveillance, R&D, Product Management and Marketing.
The role gives you the opportunity to work across the medical device lifecycle and contribute to both regulatory compliance and the continued development of our clinical evaluation processes.
Your responsibilities will include:

Plan, conduct and maintain clinical evaluations throughout the medical device lifecycle

Develop and maintain Clinical Evaluation Plans and Clinical Evaluation Reports

Conduct systematic literature reviews and critically assess clinical data and scientific evidence

Evaluate clinical safety, performance and benefit-risk, integrating evidence from risk management, verification and validation, usability and other relevant activities

Monitor emerging clinical evidence, identify residual clinical uncertainties and recommend, develop and conduct appropriate Post-Market Clinical Follow-up activities

Support regulatory submissions and interactions with notified bodies

 We offer:

The opportunity to work with state-of-the-art medical software that helps shape the future of healthcare

Challenging and evolving clinical work as new technologies, including AI, raise the bar for clinical evidence, safety and performance

The chance to influence how clinical evaluations are conducted at Cambio and contribute to the continued development of our clinical strategy

You have a strong scientific and analytical mindset and are comfortable working with complex clinical information and turning it into clear, well-founded conclusions.
You are quality-conscious and attentive to detail, with the ability to work independently and take ownership of your responsibilities. At the same time, you enjoy working as part of a team and collaborating with people from different areas of expertise. You are a clear and adaptable communicator, able to explain complex topics in a simple and understandable way depending on your audience.
At Cambio, we value initiative and personal growth. Our culture is built on Trust, Care and Together, and it is important that you recognize yourself in these values. 
Requirements 

Experience working with clinical evaluation of medical devices, either leading or contributing to the clinical evaluation process

Experience working with the EU Medical Device Regulation (MDR) and relevant guidance documents

Experience in systematic literature reviews and critical appraisal of clinical and scientific data

Good understanding of clinical safety, performance and benefit-risk assessment

Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and good communication skills in Swedish

It's a bonus if you

Have experience working with medical device software

Have experience with Post-Market Surveillance (PMS), Post-Market Clinical Follow-up (PMCF) or risk management

Have experience with clinical research methodology, clinical investigation design or biostatistics

Have experience assessing state of the art, benchmark devices or equivalence

Have experience with scientific literature databases such as Embase or Medline

About Aluwave
Aluwave is a Swedish technology company specializing in customized LED lighting solutions. We work with product development, industrialization and manufacturing in an international environment, with operations and partners in Europe and Asia.
About the role

The role combines technical project management with hands-on engineering, supplier development, quality management and cost optimization. You will work closely with our organization in Sweden and with electronics manufacturers and suppliers in China, supporting products from development and industrialization through production ramp-up and continuous improvement.

Would you like to help develop the next generation of birch forests? Join our research team and investigate how flowering and seed production can support faster progress in forest tree breeding.
Improved planting material contributes to productive and resilient forests. In silver birch, efficient breeding and reliable seed production depend on our ability to understand and influence flowering. Skogforsk is seeking a motivated PhD student to investigate these processes and develop methods that can be applied in breeding programmes and seed production.
The position is part of Phase II of Trees For Me, a centre of excellence focusing on fast-growing broadleaved trees for sustainable forests, materials and energy.

Research project and duties
The overall aim of this four-year PhD project is to improve our understanding of flowering in silver birch and develop practical methods to promote early and reliable flowering and seed production.
The project will investigate how environmental conditions and cultivation treatments influence flowering in young plants and older breeding material. Particular attention will be given to light conditions, plant development and genetic differences in flowering responses. The research will connect fundamental questions about reproductive development with practical challenges in birch breeding.
Earlier flowering could shorten the breeding cycle and help realise the benefits of genomic selection by allowing selected individuals to be crossed at a younger age. Improved control of flowering could also support more reliable seed production.
Your work will include:
Planning, establishing and managing experiments in controlled environments, greenhouses and, where relevant, the field.
Assessing growth, development, male and female flowering, and seed production and quality.
Analysing experimental data using statistical methods.
Publishing scientific papers and communicating results to researchers, breeders and other stakeholders.
Completing doctoral courses in forest genetics, breeding and related subjects.

The detailed research questions and experimental programme will be developed together with the supervisory team.

Trees For Me – Phase II
Trees For Me brings together universities, research institutes, industry and public-sector organisations to develop knowledge and solutions for the sustainable use of fast-growing broadleaved trees, including birch, poplar and aspen.
Within Phase II, this PhD project will contribute knowledge and methods to strengthen birch breeding and the supply of improved reproductive material. The student will participate in an interdisciplinary research environment and collaborate with researchers and stakeholders across the forest sector.

Research environment
The project is a collaboration between Skogforsk and the Southern Swedish Forest Research Centre at the Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU) in Alnarp. The student will be employed by Skogforsk and based at the Ekebo research station in Svalöv, with doctoral enrolment at SLU.
You will join a team working with forest tree genetics, breeding and seed production. The position offers close contact with operational breeding, access to experimental facilities and breeding material, and opportunities for national and international collaboration.

Qualifications
We are looking for a motivated and curious candidate with a master’s degree in forestry, biology, plant science, genetics, environmental science or an equivalent subject relevant to the project.
You should have an interest in experimental research, plant development and the practical application of scientific results. Good communication skills and proficiency in spoken and written English are essential.
The following qualifications are considered merits:
Knowledge of plant physiology, flowering biology, forest genetics or tree breeding.
Experience in establishing and managing plant experiments.
Experience in statistical analysis and programming in R or equivalent software.
Experience working with plants in greenhouses, controlled environments or field trials.

You should be able to work independently and collaboratively, organise your work carefully and take responsibility for practical experiments. A valid driving licence is required.
Applicants must meet SLU’s requirements for admission to doctoral studies.

Employment and application
Employment: Four-year, fixed-term employment as a PhD student at Skogforsk.
Location: Ekebo research station, Svalöv, Sweden.
Starting date: By agreement.
Application deadline: 6 December.
Your application should include:
A cover letter describing your motivation, relevant experience and research interests.
A CV.Degree certificates and transcripts.
Contact details for two referees.

Send your application to eva.persson@skogforsk.se, using the subject line “PhD application – birch”. Deadline for application is 6th of December.
For further information, please contact Mateusz Liziniewicz (mateusz.liziniewicz@skogforsk.se), Researcher, Skogforsk.

About Skogforsk
Skogforsk is the Swedish forestry research institute. Our vision is "World-class forestry for sustainable development." We develop and communicate knowledge, services, and products that contribute to the sustainable development of forestry for the benefit of society.
We operate at three locations: Uppsala, Sävar in Västerbotten, and Ekebo in Skåne. In total, we have approximately 160 employees.
At Ekebo, our research includes forest tree breeding, genetics and the production of improved planting material.

Job Description
Are you passionate about the evolving creator economy and how creators can drive both brand relevance and commercial impact? We’re looking for a Creator Marketing Lead - Affiliate & Creator Commerce to shape and build how we work with creator-led commerce at scale. 
In this role, you’ll lead the strategic direction of our creator affiliate offering and turn that strategy into scalable capabilities, ways of working and measurable business results. You’ll connect creator marketing, affiliate and commercial opportunities, ensuring our approach supports both short-term performance and long-term creator relationships. 
You’ll work closely with Creator Marketing, Affiliate, Media and local market teams to build a connected creator ecosystem and unlock the full potential of our creator partnerships across the business. 

WHAT YOU’LL DO 
As Creator Marketing Lead - Affiliate & Creator Commerce, you’ll shape the strategy and build the capabilities required to grow creator commerce across markets. You’ll translate strategic priorities into clear plans, processes, tools and technology, while driving collaboration across teams and markets. 
You will: 
Define and drive the creator affiliate and commerce strategy, ensuring it complements the broader affiliate strategy and overall creator marketing direction. 
Build scalable operating models, processes, tools and technology that enable creator commerce across markets. 
Shape quarterly strategies, priorities and budget allocation within your area. 
Work closely with markets to identify commercial opportunities and define activation plans. 
Lead and guide Creator Marketing Specialists and Coordinators in campaign execution and delivery. 
Oversee campaign execution, budget management, performance and stakeholder alignment. 
Identify opportunities to maximise creator value across awareness, engagement and conversion. 
Build strong collaboration across Creator Marketing, Affiliate, Media and local market teams, ensuring partnerships and creator relationships are leveraged strategically across initiatives. 
Balance performance and commercial objectives with long-term creator relationships and strong brand alignment. 
Use performance insights and learnings to continuously evolve the creator commerce offering and identify new opportunities for growth. 

WHO YOU ARE 
We’re looking for a strategic and commercially minded creator marketing professional who combines deep expertise with a builder mentality. You’re comfortable setting direction, but equally motivated by turning strategy into something tangible, scalable and actionable. 
You understand both the relationship-driven side of creator marketing and the performance-driven nature of affiliate and creator commerce. You can navigate a complex stakeholder landscape, influence across teams and markets and turn business needs into clear operational and technical requirements. 
We are looking for people with: 
Extensive experience within creator, influencer or affiliate marketing, with strong expertise in creator commerce and performance-driven partnerships. 
Proven experience building or scaling creator-led commercial or affiliate programmes. 
Strong strategic planning and prioritisation skills, with the ability to translate strategy into execution. 
A solid understanding of affiliate platforms, tracking, attribution, tools and technology supporting creator commerce. 
A commercial mindset with a strong focus on measurable results, business impact and optimisation. 
Experience managing budgets, priorities and performance across multiple initiatives or markets. 
Excellent stakeholder management skills and confidence working across senior, cross-functional and international teams. 
Experience leading, coaching or guiding specialists and coordinators in campaign delivery. 
The ability to balance short-term commercial opportunities with long-term creator relationships and brand priorities. 
A collaborative, curious and proactive approach, with the drive to build new capabilities and ways of working.

 
WHO WE ARE  
H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.  
We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. 
 

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE  
At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits and extensive development opportunities across the globe. You’ll be part of a collaborative environment where your ideas matter. 
 
 
JOIN US  
Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things - our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.  
This is a full-time permanent position based in Stockholm. Please apply as soon as possible by submitting your CV in English. Due to data privacy regulations, we only accept applications through our career page.  
We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.

Lead a Global Engineering Team as Manager, Machine Engineering 
As a Manager, Machine Engineering, you will lead a team of approximately 20 machine engineers located in Karlstad, Sweden and Copenhagen, Denmark supporting some of the world's most advanced pulp mills, biomass power plants, and energy projects. In this role, you will combine people leadership, project execution, and continuous improvement to help deliver high-quality engineering solutions across Europe, South America, and Asia. Lead and develop a team of machine engineers, supporting both project execution and competence development across the organization.  
Ensure high-quality, timely, and cost-effective engineering deliverables for sales, procurement, manufacturing, construction, and commissioning activities. 
Collaborate closely with the Mechanical Engineering Global Head, Engineering Excellence function, and other engineering leaders to continuously improve processes and ways of working. 
Drive a unified and global approach to machine engineering while building competence, flexibility, and collaboration across the global resource pool.  
Partner with internal stakeholders and external engineering companies to secure the right expertise and resources needed for successful project delivery and an excellent customer experience.

You hold an M.Sc. degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline. 
You demonstrate strong leadership, decision-making, problem-solving, and change management capabilities. 
You have several years of experience within machine engineering and a proven track record in resource and team management. 
You have broad knowledge of machine engineering practices, project execution, and engineering processes in an industrial environment. 
You communicate fluently in English, both verbally and in writing. Additional language skills are a plus. 
You are willing to travel internationally when business needs require it. 

To succeed in this role 
Success in this position requires a combination of strong technical expertise, people leadership, and a global mindset. You are comfortable leading through change, building trust across teams, and balancing multiple priorities in a dynamic project environment. You know how to motivate and develop engineering talent while ensuring disciplined execution and continuous improvement.
We also expect you to align with Valmet’s Leadership Principles, practical behaviours that guide how we lead, collaborate, and succeed together: 
Take accountability – Act with ownership, set clear expectations, and follow through 
Lead with courage – Champion change, try bold ideas, and learn quickly 
Build on trust – Listen to understand, be open, and create psychological safety 
Collaborate for growth – Work across boundaries, value diverse perspectives, and focus on customer value 

We offer
You will become part of a global Mechanical Engineering Management Team supporting the Pulp, Energy and Circularity business area. The role offers extensive collaboration with engineering leaders, project execution teams, technology units, business units, and external engineering partners around the world. You will have the opportunity to influence both strategic development and operational excellence while leading a highly capable engineering team. 
We offer an inspiring and challenging position with international exposure and significant opportunities for personal and professional growth. You'll work in a collaborative, global environment where innovation, sustainability, and continuous learning are valued. In addition, we provide local benefits, modern tools, and flexible ways of working that support a healthy work-life balance.
Want to know more? 
For further information about the position please contact Tuomas Etula, Senior Manager, Mechanical Engineering, tuomas.etula@valmet.com. Please note that we do not accept applications via e-mail.  We are reviewing applications on an ongoing basis, please submit your application before November 27th. 
For positions with people leadership responsibilities in Sweden, delegated Health, Safety & Environmental (HSE) responsibilities form an integral part of the role. Relevant information will be shared and discussed during the recruitment process.
We perform background checks and alcohol/drug testing for all employees in Sweden, in line with our commitment to a safe and secure workplace.  
When everything works together  
Valmet is where the best talent from a wide variety of backgrounds comes together. We work together with our customers throughout the entire lifecycle, delivering cutting-edge technologies and services as well as mission-critical automation and flow control solutions. Backed by more than 225 years of industrial experience and a global team of over 19,000 professionals close to customers, we are uniquely positioned to transform industries toward a regenerative tomorrow. At Valmet, diversity of thought drives innovation. We are committed to a respectful and inclusive environment, where people can be themselves and are supported to contribute at their best.

A Snapshot of Your Day

Imagine joining our Mechanical Engineering team for Medium Gas Turbines, where your expertise will be vital in ensuring business continuity and supporting customer order engineering projects. In this role as a System Engineer, you will engage in advanced Mechanical System Design & Development, focusing on design of steel structures and installation solutions. You will tackle rigorous Technical Design creations in NX, Analysis & Problem Solving to optimize performance and efficiency, while also taking on Project Management & Other engineering disciplines. Mentorship responsibilities to guide processes and support junior team members. Your contribution will be essential in delivering comprehensive engineering solutions in customer order engineering projects. support from concept to execution.

How You’ll Make an Impact

●       Act as the responsible engineer within customer order projects.
●       Apply the full engineering design process to adapt designs to satisfy the customer needs 
●       Design innovative steel structures and installation solutions while producing manufacturing data in NX and associated technical documentation.
●       Engage with other package systems and contribute to the overall design philosophy of our gas turbine packages.
●       Collaborate with procurement and sub-suppliers to develop robust technical solutions, addressing generic issues and conducting root cause analyses.
●       Work closely with the project team to ensure design work aligns with the current schedule, creating, reviewing, and updating documentation within your technical area.

What You Bring  
●       A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent knowledge/ experience.
●       Professional experience in a mechanical engineering role, working with complex machinery or energy systems.
●       Strong understanding of applicable norms and standards in process and mechanical engineering, both EN and ASME. 
●       Proven experience managing engineering projects, preferably from a multicultural environment.
●       Experience with 3D CAD, preferably Siemens NX and Teamcenter.
●       Background within large industrial gas turbine engineering is a merit
●       Excellent teamwork skills, with a structured, driven approach to prioritizing and organizing your work effectively.
●       Good communication in both Swedish and English is preferred.

About the Team 
You will be part of a dedicated Mechanical Engineering team focused on the design and development of medium gas turbines. Our team is committed to innovation and excellence, working collaboratively to ensure the stability and performance of mechanical systems. Our responsibilities are design of steel structures and installation solutions both in workshop assembly stage and site installation stage. Our main responsibilities areas are gas turbine/generator base plate, gas turbine unit lifting tool, gas turbine core engine service roll-out tool, service platforms etc, and to adapt this to our customers specific requirements.

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities.
